# Projects by Xavier Loo

> Companies I co-founded, products I built, and work I contributed to.

## Built & co-founded

- [Artmeet](https://projects.xavierloo.com/#artmeet): Co-founder & CTO. A marketplace connecting creative designers with recruiters and freelance opportunities. I built the platform across portfolios, applicant tracking, interviews, competitions, and community features.
- [SenangPrint](https://projects.xavierloo.com/#senangprint): Co-founder · Solo builder. A B2B printing platform for complex print specifications and vendor workflows. I built the commerce engine, dynamic pricing, vendor routing, production tracking, and internal ERP tools.
- [TheraLink](https://projects.xavierloo.com/#theralink): Solo developer · Contract. A speech therapy marketplace for Malaysia. Built the platform for discovering therapists and booking virtual, clinic, and home-visit appointments.

## Selected contributions

- [Wiseway AI](https://projects.xavierloo.com/#wiseway): Senior software engineer. Worked across the core property platform, AI integrations, and infrastructure. Built WiseProp, a streaming property-feasibility chat product, and WisePower, a solar-energy adviser for Australian homes.
- [Segi Fresh R&D](https://projects.xavierloo.com/#segi): Solo builder · R&D. Built a fresh-food shelf monitoring and alerting system from proof of concept to pilot. Combined vision-language models, object detection, IP cameras, and Jetson edge hardware to monitor shelf conditions.
- [UniLah](https://projects.xavierloo.com/#unilah): Technical lead. Led technical architecture and development across mobile and web for a Malaysian student community platform. The student app is now Honey Lemon by UniLah.
- [Codevio partner projects](https://projects.xavierloo.com/#codevio): Technical delivery & engineering. Led client delivery with business analysts, freelance designers, and developers. Built .NET APIs, web apps, admin portals, dashboards, and integrations with external systems and devices.

## Side projects

- [LOKA Maps](https://projects.xavierloo.com/#loka): Independent project. A map and navigation app for exploring Malaysia, with place search and directions for driving, riding, and walking.

## Open source

- [Agentisan](https://projects.xavierloo.com/#agentisan): Open source. A Rust runtime and MCP server for durable, bounded agent collaboration, with Claude Code and Codex CLI adapters.
- [Better Grid](https://projects.xavierloo.com/#better-grid): Open source · In progress. A framework-agnostic, TypeScript-first data grid and spreadsheet library with a composable plugin architecture.
- [Lockscreen Dah?](https://projects.xavierloo.com/#lockscreen): Open source. A macOS menu-bar app that watches for your face and locks the screen when you step away.
- [Auth0 Manager](https://projects.xavierloo.com/#auth0-manager): Open source · In progress. A desktop GUI for managing Auth0 users and organisations, with search, bulk operations, and data exports.
- [Citector](https://projects.xavierloo.com/#citector): Open source · Archived. An earlier web tool for checking in-text citations in academic writing. The repository is archived.
- [PopCat PopBot](https://projects.xavierloo.com/#popcat): Open source · Hobby. A JavaScript and Python experiment automating the PopCat challenge.

## Apps & hackathons

- [CVE Watcher](https://projects.xavierloo.com/#cve-watcher): Hobby app. Filter vulnerability reports by your tech stack, with exploit signals, source links, and practical patch guidance.
- [Road to AI](https://projects.xavierloo.com/#road-to-ai): Hobby app · In progress. A self-paced, gamified learning path from mathematical foundations towards modern AI. The curriculum is being developed.
- [Investbook](https://projects.xavierloo.com/#investbook): Hackathon demo · 2020. A short-form video concept for sharing retail-investor ideas. Built for InvestHack 2020, organised by Bursa Malaysia and CGS-CIMB.
- [Artcert](https://projects.xavierloo.com/#artcert): Hackathon demo · 2023. A creative-ownership demo built for Solana's Hyperdrive Hackathon in 2023.

## Earlier work

- [KL Properties · UM MDS](https://projects.xavierloo.com/#um-mds): Coursework. A property-data exploration project using R Shiny, from my Master's in Data Science at the University of Malaya.
- [Real-time chatroom engine](https://projects.xavierloo.com/#chatroom): Early project. Private and group channels, live presence tracking, and user management.
- [Anonymous social platform](https://projects.xavierloo.com/#anonymous-social): Early project. An anonymous posting platform with encrypted data storage and a custom moderation dashboard.
- [Club & society management](https://projects.xavierloo.com/#club-management): Early project. A management app for student clubs and societies.
